text: dsh-cache-cost-monitor 是面向 DSH Web 的缓存与费用监控插件。它监听模型流中的 usage 数据，统计缓存命中、未命中和输出 tokens，并按可配置的模型定价估算费用；同时提供 cache_report 报表、会话轮末费用页脚和输入框下方的累计统计条。适合希望了解 DSH 会话缓存利用率、token 用量和 API 费用的用户。无需额外账号或密钥，可在 bundle 配置计价参数。

dsh-cache-cost-monitor tracks DSH cache hits, token usage, and estimated model costs. It listens to model streams and provides a report tool, per-turn cost footers, and a live usage readout in the web client.

dsh-cache-cost-monitor 的功能「缓存与费用统计」：插件包装 llm/stream 流并读取 usage chunk，记录缓存命中、未命中和输出 token 用量，再依据模型价格计算估算费用。
dsh-cache-cost-monitor 的功能「缓存报告工具」：模型可调用 cache_report 查看命中率、费用、轮次数、健康度、趋势及成本明细；detail 和 limit 参数控制逐轮信息。
dsh-cache-cost-monitor 的功能「对话轮末页脚」：在已结束且符合条件的助手消息末尾显示本轮 tokens 和人民币费用；缺少费用投影时可从会话快照读取 tokens。
dsh-cache-cost-monitor 的功能「常驻累计统计条」：在 Web 输入框下方展示累计 tokens、费用、命中率和趋势火花线。
dsh-cache-cost-monitor 的费用是按配置单价和实际 token 数估算；未配置价格的模型按零费用统计，因此结果不包含折扣、重试或网关加价。

dsh-cache-cost-monitor README · ❓ FAQ：**Q：数据存在哪？重启后还在吗？**
`cache_report` 的进程内累计统计随 DSH 重启归零；每条消息的页脚数据来自会话投影（随会话落库，重启后历史轮次仍可显示）。

**Q：为什么我的消息末尾没有页脚？**
页脚只显示插件安装**之后**、且 API 响应携带 usage 的轮次；产出了文件的轮次会让位给官方 "Produced" 行。tokens 直接读会话快照（引擎自带每轮 usage），人民币费用经 `cacheCost` 投影（v0.3.1 起宿主注入 `sessionProjections`，保证投影注册）；升级后请重启 DSH 并刷新页面。

**Q：费用是精确的吗？**
按「配置定价 × 实际 token 数」估算，不含折扣、重试与网关加价；未配置定价的模型按 0 计。官方调价后在 `config.pricing` 覆盖即可。

**Q：页脚不显眼，我想更醒目/更隐蔽？**
样式是 CSS 变量 + 透明度控制，可在浏览器端自行调整；也欢迎提 issue 增加配置项。

dsh-cache-cost-monitor README · 🧮 dsh-cache-cost-monitor：> Know exactly where every DeepSeek cent goes — prefix-cache hit rate, cost, and health, at a glance.

A [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) v0.1.x that taps every agent model call, extracts `prompt_cache_hit_tokens` / `prompt_cache_miss_tokens` / `completion_tokens`, and turns them into real-time hit-rate stats, cost estimates (with official PEAK/OFF-PEAK pricing), and a cache **health grade**.

[](LICENSE)

dsh-cache-cost-monitor README · Features：| | Feature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 📊 | **`cache_report` tool** | One-line summary (hit rate / cost / health) + trend **sparkline** + per-model breakdown + 3 targeted optimization tips |
| 🏆 | **Health grade** | Cumulative hit rate → S/A/B/C/D with 🟢🟡🟠🔴 |
| 🖥️ | **Live dock readout** | Under the composer: `⌀ 1.2M tokens · ¥2.01 · hit 68% ▂▅▇█`, updates every turn |
| 📝 | **Message footer** | Each assistant reply ends with `12.3K tokens · ¥0.0123` (hover for details) |
| ⏱️ | **Peak/off-peak billing** | Auto-detects official DeepSeek windows (UTC 00:30–16:30 PEAK) |
| 💰 | **Cost budget** | Set `budgetUsd`; gets an alert + ⚠️ flag in the report when exceeded |
| 🚨 | **Threshold alerts** | Warn log when hit rate drops below config (debounced) |
| 🛡️ | **Graceful degradation** | Missing fields, unpriced models, unavailable services — logs only, never crashes |

| --- | --- | --- |
| S | ≥ 85% | Excellent |

| C | ≥ 30% | Low — cache often invalidated |

dsh-cache-cost-monitor README · FAQ：- **Data lifetime**: in-process totals reset on DSH restart; per-message footers come from session projections and survive.
- **No footer?** Only rounds after install that carried usage data; turns that produced files yield to the official "Produced" row.
- **Cost exactness?** Estimate = configured rates × real tokens; no discounts/retries/gateway markup.
